Third product candidate from Palvella’s QTORIN™ platform to be announced

Live audiovisual webcast to take place tomorrow, Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET

WAYNE, Pa., Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --  Palvella Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: PVLA) (“Palvella” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing novel therapies for serious, rare skin diseases and vascular anomalies for which there are no U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved therapies, today announced that it will host a live, presentation-only webcast tomorrow, Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET to announce a new QTORIN™ program, the third product candidate from the Company’s QTORIN™ platform. Webcast access details will be included in a press release issued prior to the event and in the “Events & Presentations” section of the Company’s website at www.palvellatx.com. A replay will be archived on the Company’s website for 90 days following the event.

About Palvella Therapeutics

Founded and led by rare disease biotech veterans, Palvella Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: PVLA) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing novel therapies to treat patients living with serious, rare skin diseases and vascular anomalies for which there are no FDA-approved therapies. Palvella is developing a broad pipeline of product candidates based on its patented QTORIN™ platform, with an initial focus on serious, rare skin diseases and vascular anomalies, many of which are lifelong in nature. Palvella’s lead product candidate, QTORIN™ 3.9% rapamycin anhydrous gel (QTORIN™ rapamycin), is currently being developed for the treatment of microcystic lymphatic malformations, cutaneous venous malformations, and clinically significant angiokeratomas. Palvella’s second product candidate, QTORIN™ pitavastatin, is currently being developed for the treatment of disseminated superficial actinic porokeratosis. For more information, please visit www.palvellatx.com or follow Palvella on LinkedIn or X (formerly known as Twitter).

QTORIN™ rapamycin and QTORIN™ pitavastatin are for investigational use only and neither has been approved by the FDA or by any other regulatory agency for any indication.

Two leading global institutional investors, including a top-five asset manager by assets under management, make PIPE raise commitments. Committed PIPE now totals $17.1 million ahead of the proposed Nasdaq listing

DUNCAN, Okla., Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- REEcycle Holdings, Inc. (“REEcycle”), a U.S.-based rare earth recycling company, and Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp. (Nasdaq: HCAC, HCACU, HCACR) (“HCAC”) today announced that they have secured an additional $15.0 million in Private Investment in Public Equity (“PIPE”) commitments from two global asset managers that are existing REEcycle shareholders, in connection with their proposed business combination (the “business combination”) and Nasdaq listing.

Both institutional investors previously invested in REEcycle, and the new $15.0 million commitments will bring their total combined investment in REEcycle to $25.2 million. Together with the $2.1 million previously committed by entities affiliated with REEcycle’s Executive Chairman and HCAC’s sponsor, total PIPE commitments raised in connection with the business combination now equal $17.1 million.

All PIPE commitments, including those of the insiders, are at $10.00 per share. However, the two institutional investors will also receive an aggregate of 999,999 HCAC shares as an additional equity incentive at closing for no additional consideration. These incentive shares will be sourced from shares issuable to certain advisors to HCAC and REEcycle, including the Advisor Shares issuable to HC Singapore and REEcycle as consideration in the business combination and accordingly, will not increase the total number of HCAC shares to be issued in connection with the business combination.

In accordance with the terms of the definitive PIPE agreements, the PIPE commitments will fund immediately prior to closing of the business combination. Closing of the business combination is conditioned on a minimum aggregate cash amount at closing of $40.0 million, and the other conditions described in the registration statement on form S-4 filed by HCAC and REEcycle with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in connection with the business combination (the “Registration Statement”), which was declared effective on November 12, 2026.

Strategic Context

REEcycle is U.S.-based technology company focused on the recovery of rare earth elements from end-of-life magnets. REEcycle uses patented systems and processes for the extraction and recovery of rare earth elements from permanent magnets to produce a mixed rare earth oxide (MREO) for use by downstream processors in the manufacture of new permanent magnets and other industrial applications. These permanent magnets are used in a range of applications, including defense applications, hard disk drives (HDDs) found in desktop computers, laptops, and large server storage systems such as data centers, electric vehicle drive motors and regenerative braking systems, wind turbine generators, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) machines, power tools, and other advanced technologies. 

According to the Center for Strategic & International Studies, China controls approximately 90% of global rare earth processing capacity and exercises near-monopoly control over the processing of heavy rare earth elements such as dysprosium and terbium. The concentration of rare earth mining, separation and magnet manufacturing outside the U.S., together with the export controls and licensing requirements imposed by China on certain REEs and magnets beginning in April 2025 and escalating in July 2026, has increased the strategic focus of the U.S. government and commercial end-users on establishing secure domestic supply. REEcycle’s proprietary process recovers critical rare earth elements as part of its standard MREO output, making it a structurally important domestic sourcing alternative.

REEcycle’s operations in Duncan, Oklahoma, are supported by a previously announced $5.1 million Defense Production Act Title III award to advance domestic critical minerals supply.

Proceeds from the financing and closing of the business combination are intended to advance REEcycle from its current demonstration operations in Duncan to commercial-scale production.

Management Commentary

Mick McMullen, Executive Chairman of REEcycle, commented:

“Two investors who know our business well have chosen to increase their stake. This capital will help us move from demonstration to commercial scale, and recycling end-of-life magnets is the fastest route to domestic supply of the magnet rare earths that U.S. defense and industry rely on.”

Justin Froneman, Chief Executive Officer of REEcycle, commented:

“With this funding committed, our priority is execution. We are focused on ramping operations at our large-scale demonstration facility in Duncan, feedstock supply agreements and first offtake.”

Alex Bono Chief Executive Officer of Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp, commented:

“This financing strengthens REEcycle’s position heading into closing and moves the transaction meaningfully toward meeting the minimum cash condition. Our focus now is completing the business combination for HCAC shareholders.”

PIPE Financing Terms

The PIPE shares have not been registered under the Securities Act. The form of subscription agreement will be filed by HCAC with the SEC on a Current Report on Form 8-K.

About the Proposed Business Combination

REEcycle and HCAC entered into a business combination agreement dated May 31, 2026, valuing REEcycle at $400 million of total equity consideration, of which up to $50 million is contingent consideration payable only if REEcycle achieves a commercial production milestone.

The transaction is subject to a $40 million minimum cash condition, shareholder approval and other customary closing conditions.

Upon closing, the combined company is expected to be named REEcycle, Inc. and trade on Nasdaq under the proposed ticker symbol “REC”, subject to approval.

About REEcycle

REEcycle recovers rare earth elements from end-of-life permanent magnets using patented hydrometallurgical technology licensed from the University of Houston. Headquartered in Duncan, Oklahoma, the company is developing domestic rare earth recycling and processing capacity.

About Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp.

HCAC is a Nasdaq-listed special purpose acquisition company focused on critical materials, infrastructure and energy, and defense-aligned technology. Its sponsor is Hall Chadwick Capital LLC.

Advisors

Empire Capital Partners Pty Ltd is acting as exclusive financial advisor to REEcycle, and Ashurst Perkins Coie US LLP is acting as legal counsel to REEcycle.

Hall Chadwick Corporate (Asia) Pte Ltd is acting as corporate advisor to HCAC. Cohen & Company Capital Markets, a division of Cohen & Company Securities, LLC, is acting as joint financial advisor, joint capital markets advisor and placement agent to HCAC, and Duane Morris LLP is acting as legal counsel to HCAC.

Teva's Pivot to Growth Strategy, R&D priorities, and expectations remain unchanged; Company initiates search for successor

TEL AVIV, Israel and PARSIPPANY, N.J., Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. (NYSE and TASE: TEVA) today announced that Dr. Eric Hughes, Executive Vice President, Global R&D and Chief Medical Officer, has decided to leave Teva and has accepted an offer outside the company. Dr. Hughes will remain with Teva through the coming months to support a seamless transition.

Effective immediately, David Gardiner, MD, Head of Innovative Medicines & Clinical Development, will serve as transition lead for R&D, reporting directly to Teva's President and Chief Executive Officer, Richard Francis, until a permanent successor is named. Teva is initiating a comprehensive search for a successor beginning immediately.

“Eric has made critical contributions to Teva and to the transformation of our R&D organization,” said Richard Francis, President and CEO of Teva. “He has helped build the pipeline, capabilities, and organization we presented at R&D Day last week and leaves Teva well positioned for its next chapter. Our strategy, priorities and expectations have not changed, and our focus remains on executing against the commitments we have made and continuing the momentum across our innovative pipeline.”

“I am incredibly proud of what our R&D organization accomplished to establish Teva as a truly innovative biopharma company and of the strong team we built,” said Dr. Hughes. “The progress we shared at R&D Day reflects the strength and depth of this organization and the exceptional science we developed together. I am deeply grateful to the entire team for their dedication, talent and partnership. It has been a privilege to lead them.”

Teva's R&D strategy and priorities remain unchanged, and the company remains focused on delivering on the commitments outlined in its November 11th R&D Day, including its ambition to generate $6–7 billion in innovative medicines revenue by 2030.

About Teva
Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. (NYSE and TASE: TEVA) is a global biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. For over 120 years, Teva's commitment to bettering health has never wavered. From innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology to providing complex generic medicines, biosimilars, and pharmacy brands worldwide, Teva is dedicated to addressing patients' needs, now and in the future. At Teva, We Are All in for Better Health. To learn more about how, visit www.tevapharm.com.

More Than 90% Employee Adoption Reinforces Capital-Light Operating Model

PLEASANTON, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- AEye, Inc. (Nasdaq: LIDR), a global leader in software-defined, high-performance lidar solutions, today provided an update on the integration of artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools across its engineering and business operations. More than 90% of the Company’s employees, and almost 95% of those in the engineering department, now use AI tools in their daily work, with AI deployed across workflows including software, firmware, and hardware engineering.

“AEye’s operating model is built around focusing our resources on differentiated lidar technology and working with established partners to scale production,” said Matt Fisch, CEO of AEye. “AI use has become standard practice and is embedded across our workflows, allowing us to keep pace as the tempo of our commercial activity increases. This enables our team to concentrate its efforts on improving our products, lowering costs, and preparing for higher production volumes. AI lets us do more with less, stay disciplined on spending, and put every dollar to work for our customers.”

FREMONT, Calif., Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Enovix Corporation (“Enovix” or the “Company,” Nasdaq: ENVX), a developer and manufacturer of advanced lithium-ion batteries, today announced that it will distribute warrants to purchase Enovix common stock (“Warrants”) to its stockholders and certain convertible noteholders on November 18, 2026 (the “Distribution Date”), in accordance with the previously declared stockholder warrant dividend. As previously announced, each stockholder of record as of the close of business on November 13, 2026 (the “Record Date”) will receive one (1) Warrant for every four (4) shares of Enovix common stock held, rounded down to the nearest whole Warrant.

“Our first warrant dividend in 2025 demonstrated the strong support of our stockholders and their interest in participating directly in Enovix’s growth,” said Ryan Benton, Interim Chief Executive Officer. “This distribution builds on that by giving investors another way to participate while helping us address our outstanding debt by permitting Warrant exercises with the delivery of our 3.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 (the “2028 Notes”). Accepting our 2028 Notes at face value as payment of the exercise price allows us to retire debt and preserve cash for the business, while cash exercises provide additional funding that we could also apply toward retiring outstanding 2028 Notes and preserving flexibility to support execution on our priorities.”

Warrant Terms

Eligibility: Stockholders must have purchased or held shares no later than November 12, 2026 to be a stockholder of record as of the close of business on the November 13, 2026 Record Date and to receive Warrants.

Convertible Noteholders: Holders of our 2028 Notes and our 4.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030 (the “2030 Notes”) as of the Record Date will also receive Warrants on a pass-through basis, as provided under the applicable indentures, at the same one-for-four ratio.

Receipt of Warrants: Eligible recipients do not need to take any action or make any payment to receive their Warrants. Holders may exercise, hold or sell the Warrants. Holders whose securities are held through an intermediary should contact that intermediary with questions about when the Warrants will appear in their accounts.

Cash Exercise Price: Each Warrant entitles the holder to purchase one (1) share of Enovix common stock for $3.00 in cash, subject to adjustments and amendments under the warrant agreement.

Note Exercise Alternative: In lieu of cash, holders may exercise 333 Warrants by delivering $1,000 principal amount of 2028 Notes. Unless otherwise permitted by Enovix, the 2030 Notes may not be used to exercise the Warrants.

Listing: The Warrants are expected to begin trading separately from Enovix common stock on Nasdaq under the symbol ENVXW on November 19, 2026, subject to applicable approvals.

Scheduled Expiration: April 28, 2028, at 5:00 p.m. New York City time, subject to early expiration and any extension under the warrant agreement.

Early Expiration Price Condition: This condition will be satisfied if the daily volume-weighted average price (“VWAP”) of Enovix common stock equals or exceeds 110% of the then-applicable exercise price, initially $3.30, on twenty (20) trading days within any thirty (30) consecutive trading-day period following issuance (the “Early Expiration Price Condition”). The qualifying trading days need not be consecutive.

If the Early Expiration Price Condition is satisfied, the Warrants will expire at 5:00 p.m. New York City time on the business day immediately following the final qualifying trading day, or a later date selected by the Company in accordance with the warrant agreement. Enovix will announce the applicable expiration date by press release.

Exercise Using Cash or 2028 Notes

Beginning on the Distribution Date, holders may exercise their Warrants using cash or 2028 Notes, subject to the warrant agreement.

The 2028 Notes are designated as eligible for exercise. The 2030 Notes are not eligible and may not be delivered as payment. The Company may, in its discretion and subject to the notice requirements and other terms of the warrant agreement, change the debt securities designated as eligible for exercise.

For cash exercises, each Warrant entitles the holder to purchase one (1) share of Enovix common stock for $3.00. For exercises using 2028 Notes, holders may deliver $1,000 principal amount of 2028 Notes for every 333 Warrants exercised and receive 333 shares. Note exercises must be submitted in whole multiples of this ratio, regardless of the market price of the 2028 Notes.

For example, a holder delivering $20,000 principal amount of 2028 Notes may exercise 6,660 Warrants and receive 6,660 shares of common stock.

The ability to exercise Warrants with 2028 Notes is available to any investor holding 333 Warrants for each $1,000 principal amount of 2028 Notes delivered. Warrants may be acquired through the dividend distribution or in the open market. Any investor may purchase additional Warrants in the market for exercise, and certain qualifying investors may purchase additional 2028 Notes in market transactions.

Any 2028 Notes delivered and accepted for exercise of Warrants will be cancelled, reducing Enovix’s outstanding debt and associated future interest obligations without requiring the Company to use cash to repay that principal. Enovix will receive cash proceeds only from cash exercises of the Warrants. Any cash proceeds will be available for general corporate purposes, including retiring 2028 Notes.

Exercise Procedures and Investor Resources

Holders whose Warrants or 2028 Notes are held through a broker, bank or other intermediary should contact that intermediary regarding receipt of their Warrants, exercise instructions, permitted payment methods and applicable deadlines.

The early expiration feature could substantially shorten the exercise period. Holders should make arrangements with their intermediaries in advance, as intermediaries may impose deadlines earlier than the Company’s deadline. Warrants not exercised before the applicable expiration deadline will expire without value.

The warrant agreement, prospectus supplement and related investor materials describe the complete terms, including exercise procedures, adjustments to the Warrants, any exercise suspension provisions and the conditions governing early expiration. The warrant agreement and related registration documents were filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) on November 18, 2026.

Additional information, including frequently asked questions, is available on the Company’s Investor Relations website at https://ir.enovix.com.

B. Dyson Capital Advisors is serving as exclusive advisor to the Company on the structuring and distribution of the Warrants.

Enovix develops and manufactures advanced lithium-ion batteries, including proprietary silicon-anode architectures for smartphones, smart eyewear, defense, industrial and emerging edge-AI applications. Its proprietary silicon-anode battery architecture enables higher energy density and performance in space-constrained devices while maintaining safety and reliability, supporting commercialization across consumer and industrial markets.

Enovix is headquartered in Silicon Valley with facilities in India, South Korea and Malaysia, serving customers globally. For more information visit https://enovix.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

The rig's insured value is $200 million, with the insurance payment due date set for November 24, 2026. Additionally, we carry comprehensive third-party liability insurance, which includes coverage related to wreck removal and pollution. We continue to assess the financial impact of the Prospector 5 incident on the Company.

Our thoughts remain with our colleagues and their families affected by this incident, and their wellbeing continues to be our highest priority.

Moving to our performance for the third quarter of 2026, our operations resulted in technical utilization of 98.0% and economic utilization of 97.3%. Revenues for the period were $263.1 million, with an average of 22.9 operating rigs. Third-quarter Adjusted EBITDA was $78.9 million, a quarter-on-quarter increase of $35.1 million consistent with our expectations. This improvement reflects higher revenues, following an elevated number of rig transitions during the second quarter, and the non-recurrence of a credit loss provision recorded in the prior period. We currently anticipate Q4 Adjusted EBITDA performance to be broadly in line with Q3, despite the Prospector 5 impact.

Turning to the market, since our last quarterly report, we have secured nine contract commitments in key geographies outside the Middle East. These include an award to deploy the previously idle rig Hild offshore Nigeria, strengthening our presence in this growing region. The nine commitments added approximately $269 million in backlog and represent more than 1,950 days of additional firm work, bringing our contract coverage for 2026 and 2027 to 79% and 52%, respectively.

We are also seeing encouraging signs for shallow-water activity, with an increasing number of opportunities in Southeast Asia and West Africa in particular. Recent market developments reflect the continued recovery in marketed utilization for modern jack-ups, which now stands at approximately 93%, compared to around 90% nine months ago, despite persistent disruptions in the Middle East.

The strategy will also focus on refining the property's retail merchandising mix and strengthening its connection to the surrounding community, while recapturing its status as a leading mixed-use lifestyle shopping center in the country.

Georgetown brings decades of experience developing, repositioning and managing major mixed-use properties across the country, including Easton Town Center in Columbus, Ohio, Halcyon in Alpharetta, Georgia, 787 Eleventh Avenue in New York City and Campus 244, an adaptive-reuse redevelopment in Atlanta, among many others.

First quarter of positive Adjusted EBITDA(1) in several fiscal years, continued cost reductions, and re-affirming revenue guidance of approximately $2.0 million in Q4 2026

Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 18, 2026) - Clear Blue Technologies International Inc. (TSXV: CBLU) (FSE: 0YA0) ("Clear Blue"), the Smart Off-Grid™ Company, announces its unaudited financial results for the third fiscal quarter of 2026 ended September 30, 2026 ("Q3 2026"). A complete set of Financial Statements and Management's Discussion & Analysis ("MD&A") has been filed at www.sedarplus.ca. All dollar amounts are denominated in Canadian dollars.

"The second half of 2026 is beginning to yield the results of our new partnerships and products," said Miriam Tuerk, Co-Founder & CEO of Clear Blue. "In the quarter, the company ramped up its production to meet the increase in sales led by the Eutelsat Konnect Wifi orders. Together with our streamlined organization enabled by AI, cost reductions started to drop to the bottom line and allowed us to deliver a more efficient Q3 with positive Adjusted EBITDA. Our focus in 2027 is to continue leveraging our existing strategic partners and execute on new ones that can give us significant scale to achieve our revenue growth goals."

For the three months ended September 30, 2026 ("Q3 2026"):

  • New bookings were $1,435,566 compared to $745,175 in the corresponding period of 2025, an increase of 93%.
  • Revenue was $1,054,468, an 11% increase from $953,972 in the corresponding previous period.
  • Recurring revenue was $139,005, a 15% decrease from $164,032 in the corresponding previous period.
  • Gross profit increased to $401,681 compared to $352,574 in the comparable period, a 14% increase. The gross margin percentage reflects a sales mix where the current and comparable periods had a higher proportion of hardware deliveries.
  • Non-IFRS Adjusted EBITDA for the period was $214,825 as compared to ($331,032) for the previous period. This was the first positive Adjusted EBITDA quarter in several fiscal years and reflects higher gross profit along with a 24% reduction in operating expenses.
  • Net loss for the period was $144,912 compared to a net loss of $789,438 in the corresponding previous period, an improvement of 82%.
  • Working capital as at September 30, 2026, was $381,043 compared to $222,940 as at December 31, 2025.

Subsequent to the fiscal third quarter:

  • Mr. Nick Blitterswyk joined Clear Blue's Board of Directors as an independent director. Mr. Blitterswyk is the founder and former Chief Executive Officer of UGE International, a formerly TSX Venture Exchange-listed solar energy and battery storage company that was acquired by a US private equity firm in 2024. He has been a longtime advisor to the Company's management, and his public company, capital markets and operating experience will support the Company as it enters its next phase of growth.

Management Commentary & Outlook

In fiscal 2025, the Company launched its "Clear Blue 2.0" business strategy. This strategy is centered around product, customer partnerships, scaling sales volumes, and generating positive Adjusted EBITDA. In its Q2 2026 earnings release, the Company provided guidance of $5 million in revenue for 2026. The Company is pleased to re-affirm its revenue guidance for 2026, resulting in an expected quarterly revenue of approximately $2 million for Q4 2026.

Furthermore, Q3 2026 saw positive Adjusted EBITDA for the first time in several fiscal years, showcasing the Company's continued efforts to increase margins and reduce costs. Q4 2026 is expected to continue the improvements in Adjusted EBITDA due to the higher expected revenue and gross margins in line with historical levels.

Going into fiscal 2027, management's goal is to continue this trajectory by delivering potential year-over-year revenue growth and more consistent, positive Adjusted EBITDA in subsequent quarters. This mandate is supported by the Company's customer demand for its new Pico, Pico+, and Senti products, along with new product launches planned for early 2027.

The Company's commercial and strategic relationship with Eutelsat continued to advance. On September 28, 2026, the Company announced that it had received purchase orders from Eutelsat for 1,000 Pico-Plus Smart Off-Grid power systems to support Eutelsat's continued Konnect Wi-Fi rollout for several countries in Africa. The units are expected to be delivered in Q4 2026, and these orders bring the number of units ordered by Eutelsat in 2026 to approximately 1,500. The orders build on the Letter of Intent signed with Eutelsat on December 17, 2025, for a three-year supply agreement targeting approximately 15,000 Pico-Plus systems, contingent on commercial demand.

Eutelsat is an example of the Company's goal to build long-term commercial relationships that can leverage its standardized products and technologies to provide scale. Clear Blue believes that this will support the Company's long-term growth goals and is in the process of developing other similar initiatives, particularly with its Pico product lines.

For the remainder of the year, Clear Blue is focused on closing the year by hitting its Q4 guidance, positioning itself to close on larger customer orders and converting its pipeline to ensure 2027 is another year of revenue growth.
